overview.description: Hero Realms is a commercial fantasy deck-building card game where players acquire market cards and attack opposing champions or players.
overview.deck: Dedicated Hero Realms market and player decks

history.origins: Designed by Rob Dougherty and Darwin Kastle and published by Wise Wizard Games in 2016, Hero Realms adapts Star Realms-style deck building to a fantasy combat setting.
timeline: Documented card-play form: Hero Realms is described as a distinct game with its own rules.

rules.objective: Build a stronger deck and reduce opponents health or meet the scenario victory condition.
rules.gameplay: Players play hands for gold, combat, and effects, buy market cards into their decks, attack opposing champions, and cycle improved decks through reshuffles.

strategy.basic: Buy cards that share faction synergies; mixed cards without draw or combat support slow the deck.
strategy.intermediate: Track the cards, suits, or resources that control the next legal plays, and avoid giving opponents a simple route to their scoring condition.
strategy.advanced: Use memory and tempo to force opponents into inefficient plays while preserving cards or resources that complete your own plan.

phases.label: Play
phases.notes: Each player plays one card to the center pile, announces the new total, then draws one from stock. Player who takes total over 100 loses a chip.

play_card.constraints: One card per turn. Card must keep pile value at 100 or less or player loses a chip.
